summary.intent: Run the audit-fix pipeline against the cipher-box UAT findings, auto-fix eligible issues with test verification and atomic signed commits, and triage the rest.
summary.outcome: Three findings fixed and committed (F-03 BYO-status wiring, F-04 migration progress stale-state rendering, F-05 batch timeout and failed-count double-counting) on branch `fix/audit-f03-byo-status-wiring`; F-08 marked not-applicable; all commits signed and tests green.

repo: Commits are SSH-signed via 1Password's op-ssh-sign; if 1Password is not running, git commit hangs indefinitely at the signing step and must be killed and retried after restarting the app.
The sandboxed shell blocks op-ssh-sign from reaching the 1Password agent; unsandboxed Bash tool calls are required for signed commits.
Committing from a subdirectory (e.g. apps/api left over after a jest run) causes git to fail; commits must be issued from the repo root.
Branch protection prevents direct commits to main; a feature branch is required even for single-finding fixes.
Audit findings are sourced from .planning/phases/*/*-UAT.md and *-VERIFICATION.md; findings can be annotated directly in those files (e.g. NOT APPLICABLE notes).

code.finding: BYO-status advisory flag was never synced on save; fix adds a non-fatal PATCH /vault/byo-status call via vaultControllerSetByoStatus after the pinning-config save succeeds, before the existing fetchQuota() refreshes the badge.

Failed migration jobs rendered stale UI and polling did not restart on a new run; fix adds key={migrationRunId} so React remounts the component after migrationApi.start(), and failed state now renders as '> migration failed: X/Y pins migrated'.

Batch timeout was 120s (worst-case ~130s real time), and updateProgress double-counted failures by accumulating them across calls; fix raises timeout to 300s, dedupes failedCidList as the source of truth for the failed count, and clamps migrated + failed <= totalCids.
F-08 (orphaned PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY / PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL in GitHub staging) annotated NOT APPLICABLE inline in the UAT doc pending Phala credits.

workflow: When a background git commit task stalls on SSH signing, kill op-ssh-sign (not just the git process), verify no stale .git/index.lock exists, restart 1Password, then retry—this reliably unblocks the signing flow.

Running lint-staged hooks inside a background Bash task adds ~15s to each commit; the 1Password prompt appears asynchronously so the user must watch for it rather than waiting for a tool notification.
Subagent executor fixes (gsd-executor) run independently; review the diff before committing rather than committing inside the agent, to avoid silent regressions.

friction: 1Password op-ssh-sign hung on three separate commit attempts before succeeding; required multiple kill/restart cycles totaling ~10 minutes of delay.
Sandboxed shell environment silently blocks the SSH signing agent, making the first commit attempt fail in a non-obvious way.
Shell working directory was left in apps/api after a jest run, causing the subsequent git commit to fail with exit 128 before the signing step was even reached.

Background task status for signed commits is ambiguous—'running' for a long time could mean lint-staged is executing or that it is hung on signing, with no way to distinguish without inspecting process state.
open_items: F-08: PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY and PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL secrets in the GitHub staging environment are intentionally left inert until Phala credits are obtained and staging TEE infra is provisioned.

Pre-existing uncommitted files on the branch (.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/phases/18-performance-instrumentation/18-VALIDATION.md, Cargo.lock, apps/api/src/metrics/http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts) are unrelated to these fixes and need separate handling before or after the PR.
Branch fix/audit-f03-byo-status-wiring is local only; needs push + PR to merge.
